thesis: The bear carries the objection to adding now: negative owner cash and a large financing program remain unresolved despite strong advertising demand. Neutral is appropriate because proposed financing is not a completed quantified loss and the evidence does not establish collapse of the recurring business.
strongest_counterexample: Revenue grew 26.07%, and excluding the separately identified legal charge yields positive underlying operating income of $22.88B; the entire reported margin contraction cannot be treated as recurring damage.
invalidation_conditions: Reconsider toward buy after two reported quarters of positive FCF on the issuer’s lease-inclusive definition and publication of completed issuance terms.
Reconsider toward sell if revenue declines year over year for two reports while FCF remains negative and total debt increases.
evidence_gaps: Completed issuance amounts and final dilution across the proposed instruments.
Investment returns and path back to sustained positive owner cash generation.
Authenticated valuation and confirmed price repair.
decisive_factors: Official lease-inclusive quarterly FCF is negative $2.12B.
Debt rose against the year-ago observation.
Planned financing adds unquantified dilution; price remains below the principal averages.
